goal:
Add the following recipes into the Broccoli app:
Recipe: Baked Cod with Lemon and Dill
 description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
 servings: 2 servings
 preparationTime: 1 hrs
 ingredients: flexible ingredients
 directions: Place cod fillets in a baking dish, season with lemon juice, dill, salt, and pepper. Bake until fish flakes easily. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

Recipe: Sausage and Peppers Skillet
 description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
 servings: 1 serving
 preparationTime: 10 mins
 ingredients: to your liking
 directions: Sauté sliced sausage, bell peppers, and onions until browned. Serve with mustard or on a hoagie roll. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

Recipe: Caprese Salad Skewers
 description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
 servings: 6 servings
 preparationTime: 10 mins
 ingredients: subject to change
 directions: Thread cherry tomatoes, basil leaves, and mozzarella balls onto skewers. Drizzle with balsamic glaze. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.
summary:
I added all three recipes to Broccoli, and each one now appears in the recipe list:

- **Baked Cod with Lemon and Dill**: 2 servings, 1 hrs, ingredients "flexible ingredients".
- **Sausage and Peppers Skillet**: 1 serving, 10 mins, ingredients "to your liking".
- **Caprese Salad Skewers**: 6 servings, 10 mins, ingredients "subject to change".

Descriptions and directions are word-for-word from your list, including the accent in "Sauté". I checked the saved Baked Cod and Caprese recipes field by field. For the Sausage recipe I checked every field in the form before saving, then saw it in the list, but didn't reopen it after saving.

To type the "é", I turned on Gboard's "Show virtual keyboard" setting, so the on-screen keyboard now stays visible.
